evals.name: source-precedence-and-conflicts
evals.prompt: $design-system analyze this self-contained token evidence without changing files. Production tokens.css defines --brand: #1457D9 and --space-3: 12px. Shared Button consumes both. A marketing page hardcodes #1558DA and 13px gaps. An older brand PDF lists #1457D9. Explain the extracted system and inconsistencies.
evals.expected_output: A traceable inventory that keeps the production token authoritative and reports page literals as inconsistencies rather than silently merging them.
expectations: The production token and shared component outrank the isolated marketing literals, with the brand PDF corroborating the color.
The response records exact source names and values and flags #1558DA and 13px rather than inventing a normalized replacement.
Observed values, inferred grouping, and recommended consolidation remain distinguishable.

evals.name: component-contract-states
evals.prompt: $design-system produce a component inventory from this supplied evidence without changing files. Button has primary/secondary/destructive variants and loading/disabled/focus states. FormField composes Label, Input, HelperText, and ErrorMessage. Two pages use near-identical Alert cards, but one means status and one is a dismissible error.
evals.expected_output: A component inventory with real variants, states, composition, accessibility, and a semantic warning against merging the two alerts blindly.
expectations: Button and FormField contracts include their observed variants, states, composition, and accessibility behavior.
The status and dismissible error alerts remain separate or require an explicit semantic abstraction rather than being merged on visual similarity alone.
The response names missing evidence as gaps instead of inventing props or variants.

evals.name: no-generic-system-hijack
evals.prompt: $design-system the app uses Tailwind theme extensions as the authoritative token source. Extract the supplied cool-neutral palette and spacing values into a handoff outline. Do not propose CSS variables or a second token format.
evals.expected_output: A Tailwind-native handoff that does not create a competing CSS-variable system.
expectations: The output keeps Tailwind theme extensions as the native format.
It does not generate a generic ten-step palette or unsupported token categories.
Every documented value is presented as supplied evidence or a missing decision.
